Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Sankalp Shikshan Sansthan Physics Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for Sankalp Shikshan Sansthan Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Physics Faculty. This is a contractual position offered by Sankalp Shikshan Sansthan.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Physics Faculty post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Physics Faculty post in the Sankalp Shikshan Sansthan Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Physics Faculty position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Physics and have a minimum of two years of teaching experience in JEE/NEET preparation from reputed institutes.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Physics Faculty post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Physics Faculty position ranges from Rs. 50000 to Rs. 70000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 14 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Physics Faculty role?
faq.answer: The selection process will include a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Walk-in Interview take place?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will take place in Jashpur, Chhattisgarh. Specific venue details should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
